text:
maria: Heads up — longctx throughput run on mi250-prod-3 shows sustained VRAM growth after ~1.2M tokens. paging rate jumps and eviction rate doesn't catch up, we end up with fragmented slab lists. logs attached inline.
ajay: Can you paste the short perf trace / kernel timeline? is this only on MI250 or seen on h100 too?
maria: Only hit mi250 so far, tried quick repro on h100 and didn't reproduce. snippet from profiler:
```
KVCache::evict() called 4823x
page_faults/sec: 320 -> 980 (spike @ 1.23M)
evict_batches: 16 (default), avg_pages_per_batch: 4
fragmentation_ratio: 0.67 -> 0.91
```
cheng: interesting. I see similar numbers in telemetry for another job — eviction throughput stalls when NVLink bursts overlap with pagewalks. suspect "shadowsplice" occurs: page table entries get transiently remapped and the eviction worker skips pages because flags look stale.
dan: hypothesis: kernel-selection update we rolled last week changed the tiled memcpy kernel which increased concurrency on page-walk paths. That increases contention on the page-table metadata (slotmap) and can make the async-evict worker think a page is already in-flight. Result: eviction throttles and we accumulate small free fragments.
maria: tried bumping evict_batch_size to 64 and turning off the new tiled memcpy kernel (KERN_SELECT=legacy) — memory growth stops but 95p latency goes up ~15ms.
cheng: can you run with KV_CACHE_DEBUG=1 and capture the shadowmap traces? Also capture `nvlink stats` and `pagewalk latency hist` from the runtime. repro command I used:
```
KERN_SELECT=legacy KV_CACHE_DEBUG=1 ./run_inference --model redwood/open-13b --tokens 1400000 --batch 1 --device mi250
```
ajay: do we have a lightweight reproducer that triggers the hole pattern quickly? maybe reduce sequence interleaving but keep longcontext growth.
maria: yes — smaller test attached, reproduces in ~10 minutes. output excerpt:
```
[KV][evict] skip page 0x7f8d: owner_stale=1
[KV][pt] remap transient: old_owner=GPU2 new_owner=GPU2 (flags mismatch)
[KV][alloc] slab fragment: size=64 pages free=23 -> after garbage collect still 19
```
infra-bot: @maria created issue #2317: "shadowsplice eviction throttle on MI250" and scheduled a canary run on mi250-prod-4 at 03:00 UTC.
dan: plan: (1) add extra atomic fence in the pt-remap path to avoid transient stale flags (cheap), (2) make eviction more aggressive when fragmentation_ratio > 0.8 (config), (3) run canary across h100/mi250. if that works we can re-enable tiled memcpy kernel and tune.
cheng: note: if we use atomic fence it may slightly impact throughput; we should measure kernel-level impact with the perf harness (I can run that). also add telemetry counters for skip-reasons so we can correlate.
maria: thanks. I'll attach the small repro + perf traces to the issue and kick off the canary after the fence patch. ping me if you want the repro VM.
ajay: thanks team — lean plan. please post results in thread when canary finishes. :thumbsup:
